findings.finding: BWM world-model plus beam solved 73/110; corresponding proposer without world model solved 5/110.
findings.scope: PlanBench Blocksworld-hard, 6-15 blocks, trained on <=6 blocks, one training seed.
limitations: Assisted system result; does not prove unaided standalone internalization.
No new reproduction, matched-compute superiority or frontier-model superiority established by this factory.

findings.finding: RCWM PREREG-2 ledger decision regret 0.544 to 0.056; four-step exact state 0.029 to 0.698.
findings.scope: 150 fresh ledger parents; fixed unmerged T2 seed-0 adapter; same generator and marginals; chain_one horizon four.
limitations: Fresh payloads are not an OOD rule-mastery claim.
Prerequisite copy shortcut persisted; register was not fixed.
Registered forgetting guard is limited and does not show general retained competence.

findings.finding: RCWM PREREG-3 returned TRIGGER: unseen no-op status strata achieved 0.01-0.18 versus trained void 0.99-1.00.
findings.scope: Ledger in one frame; three T2 seeds; 1,500 one-step audit rows and 80 four-step chains described in the report.
limitations: Not every possible status or causal rule was tested.
Rule-text inversion was explicitly excluded from this confirmation; it is proposed new data here, not an established PREREG-3 test result.
Arithmetic, renamed word accounts and key order also showed restricted generalization.

findings.finding: L8-15 failed C2 prerequisite acquisition: 96/128 to 88/128; verdict DO NOT PROMOTE.
findings.scope: PREREG-L1 promotion screen; localization had reduced some activation drift.
limitations: Reduced drift does not prove preservation of exact numeric output, acquisition or deployability.
The earlier localization mechanism finding is exploratory and cannot override the failed screen.

findings.finding: BWM surface audit: canonical accuracy 1.000; reversed JSON keys 0.458; unseen block names 0.992 and shuffled fact lists 1.000.
findings.scope: 120 generated keys at 5 and 10 blocks, reported in joint R16.
limitations: A separate diagnostic; does not invalidate the canonical frozen 73/110 result.
Size, name and serialization invariance are distinct axes.

findings.finding: Per-row trace-matched filler length leaked wrap/branch labels; D-36 amendment 4b fixes filler length per public family/domain and action kind.
findings.scope: T2b and BWM trace-control kits; preserve literal cmp/calc/after target ordering.
limitations: This is a control-design correction, not a demonstrated new dataset learning benefit.
For this factory, choose any new filler policy from TRAIN only; do not copy a test-derived maximum.

findings.finding: D-36 retention no-go on corrected category loss, category net below -11, or pooled net below -4%, under both graders.
findings.scope: Existing registered retention workflow; old -5/75 category rule is diagnostic.
limitations: This factory does not open or recreate the protected retention instrument.
No detected loss is not proof of a <=2 percentage point noninferiority bound.

findings.finding: IDR role-specific routing infrastructure is documented as CPU-tested; native Rineya efficacy remains unqualified.
findings.scope: Bundle repository-source entry R05, not a local ChatBubble code audit.
limitations: RHF/triadic memory/CSS/RHD/recurrence are overlap candidates only; local executability is not established.

tracks.name: Causal and counterfactual rule models
tracks.specification_status: proposed; generation and independent approval owned by other roles
learning_objectives: Execute the supplied predicate rather than lexical priors.
Separate applicability, exact computation and unchanged fields.
Follow different meanings assigned to the same status/operator.
tracks.oracle_contract: Independent AST predicate interpreter plus separately implemented arithmetic/state executor; integer arithmetic, complete state comparison and untouched-field invariants.
specialized_rubric: Does an explicit rule uniquely define exact string matching, case handling and precedence?
Can the reviewer recompute applicability without seeing the generator expectation?
Do counterfactual twins change only the declared intervention and retain a shared family key?
Is applicable identity distinguished from inapplicable no-op and illegal action?
Are equality, negative numbers and unfamiliar vocabulary included without answer hints?

Same rule with novel names, numbers and input order; structural difficulty remains one step.
Two predicates or strict/equality threshold exceptions evaluated jointly.
Two to eight events where later applicability or arithmetic depends on an earlier result.
Compose a new rule selection, precondition and arithmetic procedure from separately taught primitives.
Matched token-trigger, false-copy and rule-reversal traps with no prompt/target leakage.
Development challenge holds out predicate trees, magnitude ranges and renderer combinations.

tracks.expansion_recommendation: Balance apply/no-op at parent strata, cover exact threshold at -1/0/+1, and add composed predicates before increasing paraphrases.

tracks.name: Diffusion and revisable proposal models
tracks.specification_status: proposed; generation and independent approval owned by other roles
learning_objectives: Identify and repair bounded candidate errors.
Preserve valid candidate prefixes and avoid introducing new violations.
Distinguish semantic solution diversity from surface variation.
tracks.oracle_contract: Replay candidate against independent simulator; bounded edit enumeration/BFS defines repair feasibility and minimality only within declared cost/bound.
specialized_rubric: Does the original candidate actually contain the alleged defect?
Is each corrected plan executable and goal-reaching?
Is minimality proved within a visible edit metric/bound?
Are alternative equally good repairs accepted?
Does an extra revision create a regression or only reword the same plan?

difficulty_levels.task_structure: Repair one corrupted arithmetic/transition step.
Repair renamed equivalent candidates.
Repair a failed precondition with explicit constraints.
Repair the earliest failure and dependent suffix of a plan.
Repair plans composed of several reusable procedures.
Tempting local fix that breaks later constraints.
Held-out fault combinations, horizons and graph motifs.

coverage_goals.level_distribution_policy: Report observed level counts; do not force unavailable levels or relabel one-step samples as composition.
coverage_goals.challenge_axis_policy: Within every supported base level, target >=25% changed-rule/near-miss/shortcut controls where applicable; hold OOD challenges outside TRAIN.

tracks.expansion_recommendation: Add shared-start-candidate repair comparisons, ties and unrepairable-within-bound labels before masked revision tasks.
tracks.limits: A verified revision dataset is not a diffusion model; denoising speed, diversity and learning benefit remain unmeasured.
tracks.bundle_reuse: Coordinate with existing repeated-sampling/inference-compute experiments before making another proposer harness. No new model downloads or paid APIs are required by this bundle.
tracks.required_future_model_controls: Same validity checker, action vocabulary, horizon, total candidate evaluations and tuning budget. Include repair of the same initial proposals to isolate denoising from simply receiving more chances.
tracks.future_metrics: Oracle-best valid-plan coverage, selected success, unique semantic plans, redundant samples, critic error, wall time and peak memory. Diversity by token distance alone is not a target.

tracks.name: Social, opponent and character-belief models
tracks.specification_status: proposed; generation and independent approval owned by other roles
learning_objectives: Maintain separate agent observations, beliefs and goals.
Predict actions from agent-accessible information.
Track explicit promises/relationship state while separating style from factual behavior.
tracks.oracle_contract: Finite fictional event/observation simulator and explicit decision policies; use set-valued targets for underdetermined human-like behavior.
specialized_rubric: Are world truth and each agent belief stored separately?
Does the action require only information this agent observed or retrieved?
Are inferred intentions uniquely determined by an explicit policy or allowed as a set?
Are promises/corrections temporally consistent?
Are style, instruction compliance and factual consistency evaluated separately?

difficulty_levels.task_structure: One agent knows or misses one event.
Identity renaming and equivalent observation wording.
Policy conditions depend on belief and promise/goal state.
Several events with delayed corrections and action consequences.
Cooperation among agents with different observations and goals.
Omniscient-information leakage and flattering but false style traps.
Held-out event combinations, partner policies and identities.

coverage_goals.level_distribution_policy: Report observed level counts; do not force unavailable levels or relabel one-step samples as composition.
coverage_goals.challenge_axis_policy: Within every supported base level, target >=25% changed-rule/near-miss/shortcut controls where applicable; hold OOD challenges outside TRAIN.

tracks.expansion_recommendation: Start original fictional agents and exact structured actions; add language realization after belief decisions pass independent review.
tracks.limits: General human social understanding and subjective style quality are not exact-oracle claims; ambiguous behavior must be quarantined or set-valued.
tracks.bundle_reuse: Bridge to Rineya instruction-following and role-playing research. Use synthetic fictional profiles; no access to game manuscripts or private character files is needed for this research plan.
tracks.required_future_model_controls: Same observable history; shuffled identity labels; fixed style prompt; oracle belief cards as a privileged ceiling; impossible-knowledge probes. Use original or permission-cleared characters; this program does not modify the user's game repository.
tracks.future_metrics: Belief-consistent action rate, unsupported-knowledge leakage, promise/relationship consistency, recovery after corrections, instruction validity and blinded style judgments reported separately.

gaps.gap: Rule semantics versus familiar token triggers
gaps.recommendation: Use opposite supplied mappings, nonce labels and paired counterfactual rules; hold out whole predicate compositions.
gaps.verification: Exact applicability/state labels and stripped-rule token probes; same status must support both outcomes under different rules.

gaps.gap: Serialization and structural generalization are distinct
gaps.recommendation: Add input field/list permutations, names and held-out graph motifs; cross size with surface shifts.
gaps.verification: Isomorphism/metamorphic replay, renderer read-back and parent-level held-out grids.

gaps.gap: Copy/no-op heuristics can mask failed conditional execution
gaps.recommendation: Separate applicable change, applicable identity, inapplicable no-op and illegal precondition failures.
gaps.verification: Report false-copy/false-apply separately; compare copy and ignore-condition floors per mechanism.

gaps.gap: Boundary arithmetic and exact output fidelity
gaps.recommendation: Cover threshold equality and near-miss numerical errors; include carry/modulo/delete semantics only when independently implemented.
gaps.verification: Independent integer arithmetic and invariants; inspect first-error position and untouched fields.

gaps.gap: Hybrid planning success does not establish unaided reusable procedures
gaps.recommendation: Create next-action/full-plan demonstrations on fresh worlds and held-out AB/BA/conditional compositions.
gaps.verification: Exact replay and behavior criteria; future A/B/C/D plus matched SFT controls required for internalization claim.

gaps.gap: Acquisition and retention can trade off despite smaller drift
gaps.recommendation: Provide replay/skill obligations and operation-specific competence masks; preserve source retention custody.
gaps.verification: Dataset coverage only now; later model acquisition/retention matrix with prospective powered margins.

gaps.gap: Trace controls can encode outcomes through filler length
gaps.recommendation: Keep target cmp/calc/after stable; freeze filler by TRAIN/public family/action kind and keep student metadata free of gold.
gaps.verification: Identical filler within public strata; majority-baseline/MI probe; input read-back and no label fields.

gaps.gap: Memory retrieval, correction and belief evidence lack demonstrated dataset coverage
gaps.recommendation: Generate timestamped corrections, unresolved conflicts, delayed observations and exact finite belief sets.
gaps.verification: Independent provenance/query resolver and observation-consistency enumeration.

gaps.gap: Latent, revision and social tasks need sharply scoped exact semantics
gaps.recommendation: Use lossless abstractions, bounded edit repair and explicit fictional observation/policy semantics.
gaps.verification: Round-trip exactness, minimum-edit certificates and agent-specific information custody; no unsupported architecture benefit claims.

gaps.gap: Dataset quality is separate from learning effectiveness and broad intelligence
gaps.recommendation: Report semantic-parent coverage and actual review receipts; do not convert synthetic tests or proposed gains into native efficacy.
gaps.verification: Release quality gates now; separate authorized training and independent sealed evaluation in the future.

resource_policy: Local catalog annotations only; no external papers were opened or verified anew and no code/data/weights imported. Links do not clear licenses.
expansion_policy: P0 30-parent pilots first, then 150-250 accepted parents each only after exact validation and independent review. Other tracks begin small verifiable pilots; expand by missing mechanism, not count.
